contract.entry_rule: next minute first observed price after causal confirmation
contract.cost_diagnostic: 0.5 ES point deducted from directional forward return
contract.matched_control: three distinct other sessions, within 20 minutes of day clock, similar trailing ATR and aligned prior-15m move

stage_definitions.sweep: objective level penetration then close back through level
stage_definitions.sweep_mss: close through causal pre-sweep five-bar opposite extreme
stage_definitions.sweep_mss_displacement: MSS plus aligned body >= 0.8 trailing ATR
stage_definitions.sweep_mss_displacement_fvg: post-confirmation three-bar gap followed by a later first retrace; entry remains next minute, never at a retrospectively chosen touch
stage_definitions.sweep_mss_displacement_fvg_htf: same setup with aligned trailing 60-minute price move

contract.exit: conservative exact package bid at fixed 15/30 minutes
conservative exact package bid at fixed 15/30 minutes
conservative exact package bid at fixed 15/30 minutes
